name: 邱家吉
objective: This is the first course in numerical analysis for graduate students. The objectives of the course include: (1) Development and applications of numerical methods when analytical techniques are not available; (2) Numerical differentiation and integration; (3) Numerical solution of ODEs and PDEs; (4) To get familiar with different types of commercial software.
schedule:
Week 1 Introduction, some useful software and python
Week 2 Interpolation (Homework 1)
Week 3 Numerical differentiation (Homework 2)
Week 4 Numerical integration (Homework 3)
Week 5 Numerical solution of ODEs
Week 6 Numerical solution of ODEs (Homework 4)
Week 7 Numerical solution of PDEs
Week 8 Numerical solution of PDEs (Homework 5)
Week 9 (Midterm break)
Week 10 DFT and FFT
Week 11 Numerical Optimization and Root-Finding
Week 12 Finite element method
Week 13 Finite element method: COMSOL
Week 14 Finite difference method: FLAC
Week 15 Discrete element method: 3DEC
Week 16 Discrete element method: PFC
Week 17 Presentation and discussion
Week 18 Project submission
materials: Parviz Moin (2010), Fundamentals of engineering numerical analysis, second edition. Cambridge University press.
consultation: 寫 Email 或至材資館 304 室找老師
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
